        s = [ord(c) - ord('a') for c in caption]
        
        f1 = [[INF]*26 for _ in range(n+1)]
        f2 = [[INF]*26 for _ in range(n+1)]
        f3 = [[0]*26 for _ in range(n+1)]

            row_f1_next = f1[i+1]

            row_f1 = f1[i]
            row_f2 = f2[i]
            row_f3 = f3[i]
            
            for c in range(26):
                cost = c - si if c >= si else si - c
                v2 = row_f2_next[c]
                v3 = row_f3_next[c]
                row_f1[c] = cost + v2 if v2 < INF else INF
                row_f2[c] = cost + v3 if v3 < INF else INF
            
            best1_val = INF
            best1_c = -1
            best2_val = INF
            for cp in range(26):
                v = row_f1_next[cp]

                d = cp - si if cp >= si else si - cp
                val = d + v
                if val < best1_val:

                    best1_c = cp
                elif val < best2_val:
                    best2_val = val
            
            for c in range(26):
                d = c - si if c >= si else si - c
                continue_cost = d + row_f3_next[c]
                switch_cost = best2_val if best1_c == c else best1_val
                row_f3[c] = continue_cost if continue_cost < switch_cost else switch_cost

        s0 = s[0]

            if f1[1][c] < INF:
                d = c - s0 if c >= s0 else s0 - c
                v = d + f1[1][c]
                if v < total_min:

            return ""
        
        result = []
        chosen_c = -1
